timeline.voiceoverText: Westminster City Council has unanimously passed a cross-party motion condemning far-right extremism and pledging to tackle rising hate incidents across the borough.
citations: Westminster Council Stands Against Far-Right Extremism, Para 1

timeline.voiceoverText: Moved by council leader Adam Hug, the motion responds to recent anti-migrant rhetoric and commits the authority to deliver a brand new Community Equality Strategy.

visualAsset.prompt: Documentary street-level shot of Victoria Street, Westminster, London. Overcast daylight, red London double-decker bus passing, pedestrians walking, realistic 9:16 vertical.

timeline.voiceoverText: The borough represents over one hundred and eighty nationalities, speaking more than one hundred and fifty languages.
citations: Para 4: 'residents from over 180 nationalities speaking more than 150 languages'

timeline.voiceoverText: A new working group of faith leaders, youth voices, and residents will now partner with police to support victims and protect community cohesion.
Full meeting minutes and council records are available on London Local dot news.
